title: Compilation of lists of manufacturers or packers and their circulation.

checks.requirement: Evaluate the package or inspection data against the legal requirement preserved in source_text.

source_text:
30. Compilation of lists of manufacturers or packers and their circulation. –
The Director or the Controller shall compile a State-wise list of the manufacturers and
packers registered by him under rule 29 and shall circulate such list to the Controller of
the concerned State to enable the Controller to take, or cause to be taken, samples at the
premises of the manufacturer or, where the manufacturer is not the packer, of the packer.


                                CHAPTER VII-GENERAL
